title: Sorceress of the Eclipse
description: A hooded figure in a flowing black robe stands with back to viewer, arms outstretched, casting golden glowing magical sigils and symbols. The scene is set in a ruined landscape with broken classical columns, scattered melting clocks, and three blue birds flying nearby under a blood-red eclipsed black sun in a dark starry sky.
prompt: A mysterious hooded sorceress in a long flowing black cloak stands in an ancient ruined temple, casting intricate glowing golden magical sigils and runes that swirl around her hands. Broken marble columns with melting clocks draped over them are scattered across the cracked stone ground. Three blue birds fly nearby while butterflies flutter around the magic. A striking red and black solar eclipse dominates the dark starry sky filled with alchemical symbols, in a surreal and mystical atmosphere.
